apiKey: <immich api key with admin scope - create one via Immich's web UI, Account Settings -> API Keys>
frameControlUrl: <optional - http://<your-frame-ip>:8099, enables skipping webcam capture during the frame's night-mode window>
deploySshKey: <optional - used only by deploy.sh, path to an SSH private key; omit to use your default SSH key/agent>
